role: Contract-invariant engineering correction of Unit 090, whose economic outcomes were never opened because acquisition-receipt serialization failed after all immutable inputs had already been persisted.

why_ready: Unit 090 froze a public, previsible 49-month standard-expiration-week schedule and passed every outcome-free density check across all four periods, both books, all six components and all five weekdays.
Its official snapshots, schedule, six CP2 event inputs and four closed-boundary records remain present at their exact frozen bytes and hashes.

The only failed boundary was a PowerShell convenience-total calculation while preparing a JSON receipt. Zero value_b, planned-risk, stop or conditional lifecycle outcomes were opened, so no economic finding exists to rescue or rerun.

The active Goal treats environment, design and engineering faults as unlimited correction states rather than research failures. Reconstructing the missing receipt and executing the unchanged aggregation therefore completes an unread economic question without changing its hypothesis.

parent_record.fault: PowerShell Measure-Object rejected the ordered-dictionary bytes property while calculating a convenience source_bytes total after all official sources and the deterministic schedule had been persisted.
parent_record.correction: Create a plain immutable receipt from already frozen files, verify every byte/hash and execute the exact declared CP2 aggregation once. Engineering corrections remain unbounded until a complete valid economic result exists.

central_question: Does the publicly scheduled Monday-through-Friday week containing the standard monthly third-Friday U.S. options expiration materially and broadly change the current portfolio's native opportunity supply, stressed lifecycle value or stop burden relative to other normal weeks?

treatment.standard_expiration_week: Every normal SIZE_DAY server date from Monday through Friday inclusive in the calendar week containing each month's calendar third Friday.
treatment.other_week: Every other normal SIZE_DAY server date.
treatment.holiday_rule: Keep a holiday-shifted monthly expiration inside its same calendar Monday-through-Friday week; do not create a holiday subgroup.
treatment.availability: The public convention and annual calendars are known before every treated portfolio decision.
treatment.causal_limit: The schedule is a treatment label, not a measurement of dealer gamma, open interest, options volume, settlement flow or hedging inventory.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve each distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not a primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.normal_day: Exactly one SIZE_DAY server date per fresh period, retaining zero-signal and zero-birth days.
fixed_reconstruction.native_signal: Each SIGNAL_DECIDED row is one observed native passed opportunity; repeated same-day rows remain separate.
fixed_reconstruction.birth: OPEN for the five market components and PASSIVE_FILL for Passive.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle: Pair each birth with the next same-component CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE under strict alternation. Parse positive planned_risk from final detail; stressed R equals final value_b divided by planned risk; EXTERNAL_CLOSE is a stop.
fixed_reconstruction.state: Assign treatment from the birth server date and retain it through final close.
fixed_reconstruction.supply_centering: Within each period-weekday cell, subtract full-cell means from daily signal count, birth count and the indicator of fewer than three signals.
fixed_reconstruction.lifecycle_centering: Within each of 24 component-period cells, subtract full-cell means from stressed R and stop indicator.

fixed_reports.supply: Raw and period-weekday-centered signal rate, birth rate and sub-three-signal-day differences pooled and by four periods.
fixed_reports.lifecycle: Raw and component-period-centered stressed-R and stop-rate differences pooled, by two books, four periods, six components and five weekdays.
fixed_reports.contribution: Absolute period, component and weekday contribution shares for the centered stressed-R contrast.

favorable_all: favorable direction in both books, at least 3/4 periods, at least 4/6 components and at least 3/5 weekdays
maximum absolute centered-R contribution share <= 0.60 by period, <= 0.45 by component and <= 0.45 by weekday
adverse_all: adverse direction in both books, at least 3/4 periods, at least 4/6 components and at least 3/5 weekdays
strong_null_all: neither complete direction exceeds 2 periods, 3 components or 2 weekdays
books are not concordant in either complete direction

decision_translation.directional_pass: Preserve current behavior and retain exactly one non-automatic later whole-portfolio real-tick bounded risk-or-slot question in the selected direction.
decision_translation.no_field_or_ambiguous: Preserve unconditional behavior, retain no standard-expiration-week seed and rotate away.
decision_translation.invalid: Correct the environment or engineering boundary without an economic failure judgment.

forbidden_rescues: expiration day, Thursday, Friday, quarterly, end-of-month, holiday, month, weekday or clock subgroup
options volume, open interest, gamma, volatility, threshold, magnitude or interaction proxy
best period, component, direction or book selection
risk, lot, slot, admission, allocation, component, EA, Optimization candidate or Live implementation
MQL, compile, Tester, MT5, broker/account/position/order/deal query or Live restart

preoutcome_engineering_corrections.correction: The helper's repository root was corrected while retaining the exact inputs and acquisition contract.
